board: SparkFun RGB and Gesture Sensor - APDS-9960 (SEN-12787)
reason: Proximity (PDATA 0x9C) and little-endian C/R/G/B counts (0x94-0x9B) modelled as plain registers with ID 0xAB and STATUS AVALID|PVALID; datasheet-based driver decodes them and the check printed PASS on ESP32 and Pico. The gesture FIFO engine is not modelled or used by the driver.
